observation_statement: ∀ (s : State) (who amount : Nat), 0 < amount → withdrawAllowed s who amount → (withdraw s who amount true).debt who ≤ (withdraw s who amount true).collateral who / 2
proof:
by
  intro s who amount pos allowed
  unfold withdraw
  rw [if_pos ⟨allowed, rfl⟩]
  show s.debt who ≤ (put s.collateral who (s.collateral who - amount)) who / 2
  have hput : (put s.collateral who (s.collateral who - amount)) who = s.collateral who - amount := by simp [put]
  rw [hput]
  exact allowed.2.2
reasoning: The repaired withdraw guard keeps debt at most half of remaining collateral after any allowed withdrawal.
